communications.subject: Alaska Public Records Act Request: Consulate contacts
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Alaska Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Emails, together with attachments, exchanged between May 1, 2022 and the date this request is received, between any employee or official of the Department of Law and any email address ending in "gov.il." The senders and recipients are identified above; the subject matter is communications between the Department and the government of Israel; the timeframe is stated above.

2. Records relating to the attorneys general delegation to Israel organized by the America-Israel Friendship League, the National Association of Attorneys General, and the Consulate General of Israel to the Midwest from May 25 through June 2, 2024, including any invitation, RSVP, travel authorization, itinerary, or expense or gift disclosure relating to that delegation.

I ask to be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status. If applicable, I request a waiver of all fees associated with this request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
